paragraphsHtml: I'm Diego, an Electronic Engineer from Universidad Politécnica Salesiana in Cuenca. I started my career building firmware and hardware for embedded systems, and that foundation of understanding technology from the ground up led me into web and mobile software development, where I specialize today. As a Full Stack & Mobile Engineer with 5+ years of experience, I build products with Flutter, Node.js and TypeScript, with a special focus on mobile: I love how every decision counts when you have to solve a useful experience on a small screen.

"IN CODE WE TRUST." I firmly believe that clean code, based on solid principles and best practices, is the foundation of every successful solution; that's why I prioritize simplicity and solving real problems over complexity. Beyond the code, I actively take part in tech communities and volunteer as a translator at freeCodeCamp, convinced that learning and sharing as a group always beats studying alone.
